usedFor: Quora Lead Gen Forms captures leads and Brevo runs your email lists, so “New Lead” can save each one with “Add Or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead” in Quora Lead Gen Forms, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A lead who fills a form lands in Brevo, and an existing contact is updated instead of repeated.

watchOut: Leads reach Brevo only after “New Lead” polls on its schedule, so expect a short delay before “Add Or Update Contact” runs.
